descripcion: Travel guides, practical advice and authentic experiences from the Andes of Peru. Everything you need to know before you leave.

tours.title: Pallay Punchu Mountain Tour
tours.description: Discover one of the most impressive geological formations in Cusco: colorful stripes and sharp peaks reminiscent of a traditional Andean Punchu.

tours.title: Mystical Tour in Cusco
tours.description: Discover the Abode of the Gods, the Valley of the Goblins, the Huasao Wetland and the Parque de los Ents on an alternative and cultural route.

tours.title: City Tour Cusco
tours.description: Explore the treasures of the ancient Inca Empire: Qorikancha, Sacsayhuamán, Qenqo, Puka Pukara and Tambomachay.

tours.title: Sacred Valley + Machu Picchu
tours.description: Explore the Sacred Valley of the Incas and culminate the experience in the majestic citadel of Machu Picchu.

tours.title: Short Inca Trail
tours.description: Live the mystique of the short Inca Trail and reach Machu Picchu along the ancient Inca trail.

tours.title: Cusco Express
tours.description: Escape to Cusco and Machu Picchu, the ideal destination to discover Inca history, the magic of the Andes and the cultural essence of Peru.

tours.title: Mountain of Colors + 7 Lagoons
tours.description: Andean adventure to the Mountain of Colors and the 7 Ausangate Lagoons.

tours.title: Magical Cusco
tours.description: Experience Machu Picchu and the Sacred Valley in a short but unforgettable adventure. Explore temples, mountains and the living essence of the Andes.
